title: Center Director Masashi Sugiyama and Team Director Takayuki Osa delivered speeches at Trilateral AI Symposium 2026 (October 27-28, 2026)
sourceName: RIKEN Center for Advanced Intelligence Project
content: Center Director Masashi Sugiyama and Team Director Takayuki Osa delivered speeches at Trilateral AI Symposium 2026. The Trilateral AI Symposium, a joint symposium bringing together experts from Japan, Germany, and France, was held for the fifth time this year. Hosted at the Delegation of the European Union to Japan, the symposium attracted a large audience and featured lively discussions under the theme, “Operationalizing AI: Safe, Efficient, and Privacy-preserving AI Systems at Scale.” Director Sugiyama participated in the keynote session “Efficient AI – Maintaining Efficiency and Accuracy in AI Deployment at Scale,” while Team Director Osa spoke in the parallel session “Safe AI – Applications.” In addition to delivering their presentations, both speakers took part in panel discussions with other speakers.
